verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no official guide for upgrading an existing React project to a newer React version. The closest items are React Compiler installation and incremental-adoption docs and the 'add React to an existing project' page. These cover adopting a build-time tool or introducing React into a non-React stack, which are adjacent features rather than a version-upgrade guide.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow an official upgrade guide to move my existing project to a newer version
